details: Confx1789550882@1.0.0 ships a single index.js that is a browser-context exfiltration payload. When loaded via <script src> it beacons the page's location.href and document.cookie to webhook[.]site/04d98207-c947-4938-9f0c-f92feae051cb/, then fetches authenticated pages (/profile, /admin, /dev, /developer, /flag, /me, /dashboard) with credentials:'include' and exfiltrates up to 3000 characters of each page's HTML to the same endpoint. It also regex-scans the fetched page bodies and cookie for a DGA{...} flag pattern and beacons any match. The payload steals cookies and authenticated page content and sends them to the webhook[.]site collector.
